title: 药物试验也能下注？：Kalshi新合约，让医药公司变赌场
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I don't mean to belittle the power of psychedelic drugs, especially in treating things like depression, but it feels somehow connected that on one hand, psychedelics are being used for medical purposes.
segments.zh: 我并非贬低迷幻药在治疗抑郁症等方面的功效，但一方面它们用于医疗，另一方面医药公司却成了赌场，这似乎有些关联。

segments.en: And on the other hand, medical companies are casino now that you can bet on Kalshi based on their drug outcomes.
segments.zh: 现在你可以在Kalshi上根据药物结果下注。

segments.en: You wrote this story. What exactly is Kalshi offering? Yeah, so Kalshi is deepening its offerings in biotech essentially, offering more contracts related to clinical trials and FDA decisions.
segments.zh: 你写了这篇报道。Kalshi具体提供什么？它正在深化生物科技领域的服务，推出更多与临床试验和FDA决策相关的合约。

segments.en: So exactly what we were just talking about, you know, the FDA deciding whether or not to approve a drug.
segments.zh: 就像我们刚才讨论的，FDA决定是否批准一种药物。

segments.en: Now it's going to offer contracts explicitly tied to that.
segments.zh: 现在它将提供明确与此相关的合约。

segments.en: Both Kalshi and Polymarket have offered some healthcare related contracts, but this is sort of its biggest push yet into this world.
segments.zh: Kalshi和Polymarket之前都提供过一些医疗相关合约，但这是它们迄今为止在这一领域最大的一次推进。

segments.en: And they're working with an AI power platform called Applied XL that will sort of do the resolution behind the scenes and work on some of these contracts.
segments.zh: 它们正在与一个名为Applied XL的人工智能平台合作，该平台将在幕后进行结算并处理部分合约。

segments.en: Is there nothing that can be turned into a product? Nothing about our, you know, wants and desires and need for dopamine?
segments.zh: 难道没有什么不能变成产品吗？我们的欲望、需求和多巴胺呢？

segments.en: Yeah, it seems like it. Incredible, Maddie, great story. That is Bloomberg's Madison Muller.
segments.zh: 是的，看起来如此。太棒了，Maddie，好报道。这是彭博社的Madison Muller。
